name: MSLR-Bench
description:
MSLR: Multi-Step-Reasoning-Trace Chinese Multi-Step Legal Reasoning Benchmark Dataset
	

  With the rapid development of large language models (LLMs) in legal applications, systematically evaluating their reasoning ability in judgment prediction has become increasingly urgent. Currently, publicly available legal evaluation benchmarks lack a unified evaluation framework and do not adequately support these two tasks.
